cards_included.description: Fade the tired home team: when the home team is on a back-to-back and the road team is rested, bet the road team ATS — gated to road favorites laying under 10 points (Kalshi reprice, Nov 19). Gated backtest: n=215, 61.9% win, +18.1% ROI, CI (+5.7%, +30.5%). Road dogs and double-digit lines show no edge and are excluded. Yes on the road team's exact-line KXNBASPREAD market; exact line only, 53c taker hard cap. In-sample — unproven live.
cards_included.hold_reason: Gate does not reproduce on Grok's window (reconciliation Nov 19): on the shared window the gate is +9.3% with CI including zero, and the +18.1% headline is carried by 2021-22 (gated 75%, n=56), the season Grok's window drops. Newest seasons point the wrong way (2025-26 47.6% ungated, 2026-27 so far 40.7%). Hold until the gate is re-tested on Grok's exact 548-game list. Kevin confirmed 2026-11-19 10:00 PT.

cards_included.description: Fade the model's CFB totals over-leans: when FULL_SLATE leans OVER a CFB total, the desk signal is UNDER.
